notes.note: Added the release-versioning contract paragraph and the scoped-rule pointer; checked each stated condition against scripts/lib/release-versioning-review.mjs (consumed .changeset note required, committed bytes only, whole-file package.json only, same range operator, historical CHANGELOG record, one section for the sibling manifest's new version above an unchanged tail, exact cover of consumed summaries plus dependency lines) and against its callers in documentation-freshness.mjs and review-history.mjs. The text states it proves provenance, not accuracy or publication.

Replaced the claim that regenerating the version PR replaces its formatting corrections: the changelog generator is now scripts/changeset-changelog.mjs (wired in .changeset/config.json) and the review-ledger contract accepts the generated output; a version-value citation still needs a note, matching the contract. Deploy-ledger maintenance skip unchanged.

Only the changelog generator path changed, to ../scripts/changeset-changelog.mjs, a wrapper over @changesets/cli/changelog that trims trailing whitespace. Fixed group, access, base branch, internal-dependency and private-package settings are unchanged, so no citing claim about release sets or publication changes.
